news.headline: Nvidia sell-off continues: Chipmaker stock plunges 9% as Jensen Huang faces espionage controversy
news.summary: Nvidia has opened an investigation following CEO Jensen Huang's connection with an executive linked to intelligence efforts. The company announced this after Huang acknowledged his relationship with the executive, raising concerns over security. Nvidia's shares plummeted 8% amidst uncertainty surrounding Huang's future as CEO. Analysts believe Huang's leadership is crucial for Nvidia's ongoing success in AI technology.

news.headline: MakeMyTrip's India arm gets Sebi nod to float IPO
news.summary: MakeMyTrip's India subsidiary, MMT India, has received approval from Sebi for an initial public offering. This approval follows a confidential filing of draft papers made in July. The IPO will involve the sale of equity shares by MakeMyTrip and its subsidiary, ibibo Group Holdings. Proceeds from the sale are expected to enhance the cash position of the parent company.

news.headline: Explained: Why Nvidia shares dropped 4% in overnight trade and what analysts warn can trigger a bloodbath?
news.summary: Nvidia shares dropped over 4% after CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged an affair with Alice Huang. Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice, a Chinese national, raised security concerns following intelligence reports. Nvidia has initiated an investigation into these allegations, although the board believes no secrets were compromised. Analysts suggest the company's upcoming earnings report will be crucial for market sentiment. Concerns linger over Huang's position if further evidence of wrongdoing emerges.

news.headline: TSMC to invest up to $1 billion in Anthropic, OpenAI
news.summary: TSMC is set to invest up to $1 billion in the AI landscape, directing $500 million each to Anthropic and OpenAI. As Anthropic prepares for its IPO, this financial move by TSMC underscores its belief in a booming AI industry. With surging demand for AI chips, TSMC also aims to enhance its production capabilities, reinforcing its role in evolving AI infrastructure.

news.headline: Why Rocket Lab shares fell despite record revenue and booming Neutron demand
news.summary: Rocket Lab shares fell over 6% in after-hours trading after the company reported a wider-than-expected Q3 loss despite record revenue and a growing order backlog. Investors also weighed Neutron's delayed maiden launch, higher development costs and upbeat fourth-quarter revenue guidance.

news.headline: Anthropic retracts details of $69 billion IPO filing sent to bankers. Why analysts are raising worries over valuations
news.summary: Anthropic initially shared its IPO filing details but later retracted the information due to inaccuracies. The company aimed to sell approximately 867 million shares priced between $70 and $80 each. A follow-up email clarified that these pricing details were incorrect. Anthropic indicated that an updated filing would be provided later. The company has chosen not to provide further comments regarding the situation.

news.headline: RBI said to query bank valuations of some bond derivative trades
news.summary: India's central bank has informed some lenders about the need to adjust bond forward accounting practices. This change could impact billions of dollars in assets across the banking sector. The Reserve Bank of India suggested using Level 3 inputs for valuing bond-forward trades during recent audits. Banks have been in discussions with industry associations and clearinghouses for potential solutions and better pricing information.

news.headline: FIIs cut stake in 10 smallcap stocks for 3 consecutive quarters; shares fall up to 70% in CY26
news.summary: FIIs reduced stakes in 235 BSE smallcap companies for three consecutive quarters. Nine stocks suffered 50–70% declines in CY26, highlighting sustained foreign investor selling and significant market corrections.​

news.headline: RBI's $239 bn forward dollar position to limit rupee gains despite FPI inflows: Report
news.summary: The Reserve Bank of India currently has a net short position of USD 239 billion in the forward market, which may hinder the rupee's ability to strengthen, even as foreign portfolio investor inflows improve. This influx could potentially be managed by the Reserve Bank, capping any gains for the rupee against the US dollar.

news.headline: India short bonds may underperform on rate hikes, cash squeeze
news.summary: India's bond market is experiencing changes due to recent interest rate hikes and tightening liquidity conditions. The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to raise interest rates significantly in the coming months. Short-term bonds are expected to be more sensitive to these monetary conditions, leading to their underperformance. There are expectations for the yield curve to flatten further as short-term yields rise.

news.headline: US stocks: Dow Jones falls 200 points as hot inflation revives rate-hike fears; Nvidia sinks
news.summary: On Tuesday, Wall Street faced a downturn as inflation figures surpassed projections, raising worries about potential interest rate hikes. The declines were evident across the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite indices. While financial stocks showed minor gains, technology shares, especially Nvidia, experienced fluctuations due to uncertainty in leadership. Anthropic's looming IPO threatens to heat up competition in the AI field.

news.headline: Anthropic's IPO: A close look at AI frontrunner's rapid growth, spiraling costs
news.summary: Anthropic aims to raise up to $64.4 billion in an upcoming IPO, representing a significant market debut. The company plans a valuation of up to $1.02 trillion, showcasing its ambitions in AI. Founded by former OpenAI researchers, Anthropic's revenue has rapidly surged with enterprise adoption of its AI models. While facing substantial operating losses, the company remains committed to its substantial infrastructure investments.

news.headline: US Treasury yields rise as Fed's Waller presses rate hike case
news.summary: Following remarks from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller, short-dated Treasury yields saw an uptick, as he proposed the necessity of action despite seemingly moderated inflation data. Waller highlighted a possible half-point rate increase if inflation intensifies, signaling potential shifts in monetary policy. Economists expect a modest rise in core inflation, guiding market anticipations as money markets now fully reflect a 25 basis point increase in December.

news.headline: Why The Trade Desk stock surged 15% despite revenue decline
news.summary: The Trade Desk shares surged 15.5% following stronger-than-expected Q3 earnings and revenue, as AI innovations, Netflix integration, strong customer retention and optimistic Q4 guidance boosted investor confidence despite declining profitability.

news.headline: Anthropic plans IPO live stream with Amodei, JPMorgan CEO Dimon
news.summary: Anthropic PBC is preparing for a live-streamed event featuring CEO Dario Amodei and JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon. This event is aimed at marketing their upcoming initial public offering, which might break records. The IPO is set to begin marketing shortly and is planned to debut before the Thanksgiving holiday. Anthropic is targeting an offering size similar to SpaceX's IPO, which raised significant funding.
